Name: Hoshea, King of Israel
Summary: Hoshea, son of Elah, slew Pekah, then conspired with So of Egypt and withheld Assyria's tribute; Shalmaneser besieged Samaria three years, and Israel was carried away to Assyria for its sins.
KeyStory: Hoshea's conspiracy and the fall of Samaria.
RelatedPeople: Pekah, King of Israel; So, King of Egypt; Shalmaneser, King of Assyria; Elah, Father of Hoshea
LifeLesson: The last king of Israel shows where a long road of idolatry ends: exile.
